common_properties.label: Label Position
common_properties.description: Where the label sits in view mode. Edit mode is unaffected — a Material field floats its own label.

common_properties.label: Default Value
common_properties.description: Pre-fills the field when its value is null/undefined. A blank value entered by the user is kept. For fields bound to the data model, the default defined there takes precedence.

common_properties.label: Default From State
common_properties.description: State variable to seed this field from when its value is empty. Takes precedence over Default Value and the data model default. Once set, the field also writes its value back to this state variable on every change, in addition to the normal page-data update.

common_properties.label: Default State Scope
common_properties.description: Which state the variable lives in. App state is shared across every page in the process.

common_properties.label: Form Field
common_properties.description: Mark this component as a form field for data collection

common_properties.label: Value Change Payload
common_properties.description: What an On Value Change action receives. Whole Record sends the full record — the card's row or the page data — which on a board row includes the query's computed columns. Changed Field Only sends just this field with its previous value in old_entity_data, the way a grid cell edit does.

common_properties.label: Mandatory Conditions
common_properties.description: Logic expression for mandatory status. Use @ to select fields.

common_properties.label: Disabled Conditions
common_properties.description: Logic expression for disabled status. Use @ to select fields.

common_properties.label: Editable Hover Background
common_properties.description: Tint painted behind the control when it is hovered in view mode and Editable is on — the hint that a double-click opens the editor. Blank uses the theme surface tint.

value_change_event.applies_when: the component sets the common `identifier` property (i.e. it is bound to a page-data field)

StateFormula.name: source
StateFormula.description: Rows the aggregate runs over. 'pageDataArray' (the default) is the page's own record array. `'state:<key>'` aggregates over an array held in page state instead — which is how a grid's selected rows get counted or summed: the grid's On Selection Change writes `selection.selected_rows` into state, and a formula reads it back from there.

EruPage.name: data_source
EruPage.description: Seed this page's data from a state variable when it is opened on its own (navigate-to-page, deep link, viewer) — the standalone equivalent of the page_ref `data_source: 'state'` mapping. Inside a page_ref the mount point wins: a page_ref with its own `data_source: 'state'` feeds the page, so the same page can be reused by several page_refs each handing it a different record. When the page_ref declares no state source, this declaration applies there too. 'none' (or absent) leaves page data alone.

EruPage.name: state_scope
EruPage.description: Which store the field is read from. Defaults to 'page'.

EruPage.name: state_field
EruPage.description: State variable holding the record for this page.

EruPage.name: state_result_path
EruPage.description: Optional dotted path into that value before it is used.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: record_source
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // `set-page-data`: where the record comes from. 'event' (default) is the // record the event itself carries — a grid row select hands over the selected // row, already shaped {entity_id, entity_data}. 'state'/'app_state' read a // variable named by `state_key` instead.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: record_path
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Optional dot path into that source, for when the id or record sits inside // it rather than at the top (e.g. 'extras.program_id', 'entity_data.id').

ComponentEventSubscription.name: state_scope
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Scope for `update-state`. 'page' (default) writes the current page's state; // 'app' writes the window-wide app state held on the root store, which // survives nav_outlet page swaps and is readable anywhere as `@app.<key>`.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: nav_params
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Extra query params written alongside the page id by `navigate-to-page`.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: payload_extras
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Author-supplied additions to this subscription's payload, resolved when the // event fires. The event itself only knows what the component can tell it — a // drill click carries the row and the cell, but not the page state the report // was filtered by. These land under `payload.extras`, namespaced so they // cannot collide with the record's own fields.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: value_expression
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Optional expression for set-field / update-property. When set, the value is // computed at runtime via the logic evaluator (e.g. "@view == 'kanban' ? 'board' : 'table'") // and takes precedence over the static `value`.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: action_name
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Grid 'Custom Action' (event: 'custom_action'). One subscription per action // offered on a grid row: these three describe the icon the grid renders, the // rest of the subscription is what runs when it is clicked. `action_name` is // the identity the click comes back with, so it must be unique per grid.

ComponentEventSubscription.name: drill_column
ComponentEventSubscription.description: // Grid 'On Drill' (event: 'on_drill'). The column this subscription drills // from — a column name in table mode, or an aggregation name in pivot mode. // A column named by any on_drill subscription renders its cells as links. // Several subscriptions may name the same column; all of them run on click.

EruComponent.type: { classes: string; responsive_classes: ResponsiveClasses; responsive_styles: ResponsiveStyleProperties; custom: Record<string, any>; }

properties.label: Dimensions
properties.description: Columns to group the rows by. The first draws by default; add more to offer a selector above the chart. Top N caps a dimension to its highest N categories and clubs the rest into one "Others" mark — 5 draws 6; blank plots all. Drill Into names the column a click on that dimension opens, and the drill keeps the same measure throughout.

properties.label: Inline Drill

properties.label: Wrap Columns
properties.description: On: columns that no longer fit wrap onto the next row, so a narrow viewport stacks them one below another. Off: every column stays on one row and the board scrolls horizontally — usually what you want on wide viewports. Set per viewport.

properties.label: Card Height (px)

properties.label: Card Gap (px)
properties.description: Extra vertical gap in pixels between board cards, on top of the Card Padding gutter each card already has.

properties.label: Card Padding (px)

properties.label: Card Selected Background

properties.label: Card Selected Outline
properties.description: Outline/ring colour of the active board card — stays visible over opaque custom cards. Blank = default.

properties.label: Column Count Text
properties.description: Text colour of the "3 of 12" chip in each board column header. Blank = default.

properties.label: Column Count Background
properties.description: Background colour of the "3 of 12" chip in each board column header. Blank = default.

properties.label: Token: Primary

properties.label: Token: On Primary

properties.label: Token: Surface (row bg)

properties.label: Token: Surface Container (header bg)
properties.description: Header / container surface — the header background. Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Token: Surface Container High
properties.description: Elevated surface (hover/selected rows). Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Token: Header Text
properties.description: Header text colour. Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = falls back to row text colour.

properties.label: Token: On Surface (row text)
properties.description: Row text colour (header falls back to this unless Header Text is set). Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Token: On Surface Variant
properties.description: Secondary text / icons. Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Token: Outline
properties.description: Borders / grid lines. Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Token: Outline Variant
properties.description: Subtle borders / dividers. Switch preset to Custom to edit; blank = grid default.

properties.label: Cell Selection

properties.label: Column Resizable

properties.label: Column Reorderable

properties.label: Filtering

properties.label: Sortable

properties.label: Sort Bar

properties.label: Group Bar

properties.description: Where the action column sits. "First" places it after the selection checkbox when selection is enabled.

properties.label: Action Display

properties.label: Subtotal Row

properties.label: Subtotal Column (pivot)
properties.description: Add a subtotal COLUMN per column dimension. Pivot only — a table has no column dimensions to total across.

properties.label: Subtotal Label

properties.label: Grand Total Row
properties.description: Add one grand-total row over every row the grid covers. Table mode computes it server-side; pivot computes it in the browser.

properties.label: Grand Total Row Position
properties.description: Whether the grand-total row sits above the first group or below the last

properties.label: Grand Total Column (pivot)
properties.description: Add a grand-total COLUMN across every column dimension. Pivot only.

properties.label: Grand Total Column Position (pivot)
properties.description: Where the pivot grand-total column sits

properties.label: Replace Zero Value

properties.label: Show Excel Icon

properties.label: Response Key

properties.label: Align Content

properties.label: Grid Auto Columns

properties.label: Grid Auto Rows
